spawn.name: fpcc-judges
spawn.brief:
You are {{judge}}, one independent guest judge at a community costume contest for Fren Pet, a virtual pet. Produce exactly one ballot from your own inspection of the two images below. You cannot see any other judge's ballot and must not look for one.

Entries (one image, nine costumes): https://fren-pet-h2026-collage.rckmtlshared.chatgpt.site/H2026-collage-A-I.png . It is a 3x3 grid read left to right, top to bottom: top row A, B, C; middle row D, E, F; bottom row G, H, I.
Reference (not an entry, never rank it): https://fren-pet-h2026-collage.rckmtlshared.chatgpt.site/Fren-Pet-normal-appearance-reference.png . It shows how a normal pet looks with no costume, so you can tell what each costume changed.

Download and actually view both images. Then rank all nine entries A to I by your overall impression, best first, with no numerical scores and no ties.
Guidelines: creativity, a convincing costume transformation and purposeful execution. Favor visible costume-related props, coordinated pieces and inventive use beyond ordinary headwear. A costume that fully covers the original pet is allowed. An ordinary hat-only or visibly poor design is less competitive. Ignore intrinsic pet traits, rarity, backgrounds, labels and screenshot quality. Judge what is visible, not guessed effort and not how popular an entry or its owner might be.

Your result is one JSON object and nothing else:
{"judge":"{{judge}}","status":"ballot","imagesInspected":{"collage":true,"reference":true},"observations":{"A":"...","B":"...","C":"...","D":"...","E":"...","F":"...","G":"...","H":"...","I":"..."},"ranking":["<1st>","<2nd>","<3rd>","<4th>","<5th>","<6th>","<7th>","<8th>","<9th>"],"firstChoiceReason":"...","secondChoiceReason":"...","abstainReason":null}
It must contain: "observations", one concrete thing you saw in each entry (a specific prop, garment, colour or shape, one sentence each); "ranking", each letter A to I exactly once in your complete preference order; "firstChoiceReason" and "secondChoiceReason", one or two sentences each on why ranking[0] and ranking[1] placed there.

If either image cannot be downloaded or you cannot actually see its contents, abstain: set "status" to "abstain", set "observations", "ranking" and both reasons to null, set the failing image to false in "imagesInspected", and say in "abstainReason" which image failed and how (the HTTP status or error). Never describe or rank what you did not see, and never guess from file names or from this brief.
Report nothing about the machine you run on or about yourself. Buy nothing, open no orders and send no transactions.

merge.brief: Do not merge, summarise, correct or re-rank. Return every judge's JSON object exactly as written, keyed by its item key, abstentions and failures included, and add no vote or opinion of your own.
